learning.learning_goal: Connect number names, numerals, and groups from 13 through 15.
learning.big_idea: A number tells how many dots there are.
novice_success_criteria: Recognize a number name and count a new arrangement.

screens.title: Meet 13–15.
screens.audio: Listen to the numbers. Count the dots. Then try it yourself.

screens.title: 13 — thirteen
screens.audio: This is thirteen. Tap the dots to hear them in order.

visual.ariaLabel: 13 blue dots. First ten, then 3 more.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count every dot once. Choose the number.

screens.label: Make a group
screens.title: Make 15 dots.
screens.audio: Add dots until you have fifteen. Then check.
screens.wrongFeedback: Count your dots again. You need 15.
screens.tooFewFeedback: You need 15 dots. Add a dot, then count again.
hints: Touch each dot as you count.
screens.tooManyFeedback: You need 15 dots. Remove a dot, then count again.
